hero.description: I love participating in community projects, building, studying economics, illustrating and writing. A curious mind with too many tabs open.

about.p1: I like figuring out how things work, whether markets, river-robots, or sentences, and then trying to make something useful with what I learn.
about.p2: I grew up in São Paulo, Brazil, and now live in a small town in Portugal, where I study at Stanford Online High School. Most of what I do started close to home: a composting project, a buoy that checks the water-quality in local rivers, tutoring kids in math and adults in art.
about.p3: At school I'm drawn to economics, math and computer science. Outside of it, I compost, illustrate and write. I edit our school newspaper and write poetry, sometimes about math and at other times about the beauty of bogs.

projects.title: Leve
projects.imageAlt: Leve community composting workshop in Caldas da Rainha
highlights: Operates three dedicated sub-projects: BioRainha (urban composting), Art Caldas (intergenerational arts), and Me Leve (food redistribution).
Officially adopted by Caldas da Rainha Town Council with an allocated dedicated community land plot.
Recipient of the prestigious international Diana Award (2026) for youth humanitarian and community action.
desc: A youth-led initiative working on food waste and on bringing younger and older people in town together. It runs three projects: Composting, Art Caldas and Me Leve.
So far we've worked with 8 schools and around 500 people, and saved over 1,000 meals. Leve received the Diana Award in 2026.

projects.title: Rowbot
highlights: Multi-parameter telemetry telemetry array: temperature, turbidity, conductivity, pH, and water elevation level.
Solar-powered autonomous telemetry for continuous real-time water quality monitoring in estuaries and rivers.
Recognized with the CREST Gold Award from the British Science Association.
desc: A semi-autonomous buoy (patent-pending) that measures temperature, turbidity, conductivity, pH and water level in rivers and lakes, so local water quality can be tracked in real time.
It was a finalist for the Bright Future Global Prize (awarded €5000) and received a CREST Gold Award from the British Science Association.

researchItems.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence Discourse on Short-Term Trading Volume: Evidence from S&P 500 Earnings Calls
researchItems.where: George Mason University, with Dr. Mariia Petryk
researchItems.desc: I looked at 4,892 earnings calls to see whether mentions of AI move short-term trading volume. They do (p < 0.05). Published in the Journal of Students-Scientists’ Research.

researchItems.title: Estimating Promotional Response from Statistical Twins with Coarsened Exact Matching and Self-Organizing Maps
